bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
stage="$root/.worktrees/menu-idempotent-8dc8d56-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = 8dc8d5638e7711688be549acf1127ea5bc09b1c1 || exit 60
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 61
expected="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:shared-a1b687d)"
next="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:idem-8dc8d56)"
container="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])gaybbs([-_]|$)' | head -n1)"
test -n "$container" || exit 62
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$expected" || exit 63
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$container")"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}' "$container")" = gaybbs || exit 64
docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" config --quiet >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 65
docker image tag "$expected" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:pre-idem-20261115
docker image tag "$next" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
if ! docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/tmp/gace-idem-rollout.log 2>&1;then
 docker image tag "$expected" gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:local
 docker compose -p "$project" --project-directory "$root/deploy" -f "$stage/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml" up -d --no-deps --no-build --force-recreate gaybbs >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
 exit 66
fi
sleep 8
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$container")" = true || exit 67
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$container")" = "$next" || exit 68
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 69
echo GAYBBS_SHARED_IDEMPOTENT_RUNTIME_IMAGE=PASS
